Name of Work: Annual Maintenance Contract of 01(One) number of 80 KW Thyristorised Power Supply (Make: Technocrats Plasma Systems Limited, S/N: 110301669) for a period of 01 (One) year. Location of worksite: The proposed work is in Centre of Plasma Physics - Institute for Plasma Research (CPP-IPR) located at Nazir akhat, Sonapur, Kamrup(M)-782402, Assam. Scope of Work: The scope of work includes the maintenance of the above mentioned equipment for a per iod of one (01) year. 1. The Service Provider shall conduct mandatory two (02) preventive maintenance visits to the institute and on-call attendance for fault rectification of the equipment as and when required. 2. The service provider shall attend to all complaints within seven (07) working days or within such time fra me as may be mutually agreed upon by both parties. 3. The service provider will perform thorough checking of the equipment during each visit, and a comprehe nsive service report shall be generated. 4. The Service Provider is responsible of timely deployment of professionally qualified personal with the req uired tools, tackles and instruments for uninterrupted operation of the equipment. 5. The Service Provider shall assign a competent engineer to investigate the root cause of any fault or malf unction that occurs during the maintenance period. This engineer is responsible for diagnosing issues and proposing appropriate solutions. 6. After each service visit, a detailed report outlining the performed service and suggestions for any necess ary changes must be submitted to the institute. 7. Service Hours: Maintenance of the equipment shall be carried out on working days (Monday to Friday) f rom 9:30 AM to 5:00 PM, excluding all national holidays. 8. Guide to Repair: If any major breakdown rectification work required, beyond the scope of this agreeme nt, must be conducted after inspection and estimation, based on prevailing rates. 9. The Service Provider will maintain a record of all preventive and breakdown maintenance actions in the l og book of 80 KW Thyristorised Power Supply as per prescribed requirements. Any fault noted during preve ntive maintenance beyond the scope of this agreement may be informed to department immediately for t aking necessary remedial action. Routine and Preventive Maintenance Schedule: The following routine and preventive maintenance tasks shall be performed regularly to ensure the reli able and efficient operation of the 80 KW Thyristorised Power Supply: a. General machine inspection b. System diagnostics c. Cleaning of key components

d. Plasma power source health check e. Routine calibration The successful bidder must follow this maintenance schedule diligently to ensure the reliable and effici ent operation of the equipment. This contract covers routine and preventive maintenance activities an d does not include major repairs or the supply of consumables, which may be addressed separately as needed. The service provider is responsible for maintaining detailed records of all maintenance actions perform ed on the 80 KW Thyristorised Power Supply and promptly reporting any issues beyond the scope of thi s agreement for further evaluation and remediation. GENERAL: In addition to the specific scope of work outlined above, the following general terms and conditions apply: · The Service Provider shall prioritize safety in all aspects of maintenance activities, considering t he well-being of both personnel and equipment. In the event of an accident, the Service Provider w ill bear full responsibility, and any liability arising from such incidents will be the sole responsibility of the Service Provider. · The Service Provider is obligated to strictly adhere to all safety, security, and labor regulations t hat are in effect during the execution of the AMC. Full compliance with these regulations is mandat ory. · It will be the entire responsibility of the Service Provider to insure his employees against all risks . It will be the liability of the Service Provider to meet claims over the lives of any employee engag ed by them. These general terms are established to ensure the readiness, safety, and accountability of the Service Provider in delivering non-comprehensive maintenance services as outlined in the Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) for the 80 KW Thyristorised Power Supply. Compliance with these terms is obligatory th roughout the duration of the contract. 4. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 5. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 6.
